title: Join us
text: 우리가 어떻게 늙어가는지 이해하고, 이를 해결하기 위한 방법을 찾기 위한 여정을 함께할 멤버를 모집합니다.

title: Join us
text:
연구실 문화
우리는 스스로 최신 지식을 탐구하며 노화 분야의 전문가로 성장하는 구성원과 함께하고 싶습니다. 팀의 케미스트리를 무엇보다 중요하게 생각합니다.


호기심
스스로 질문하고 공부하는 자기 주도적인 연구자


Team Chemistry
모든 구성원이 서로에게 힘이 되는 호혜적인 연구실


소통
PI, 다른 구성원, 공동연구자와 적극적으로 소통하는 연구실

title: Join us
text:
모집 분야
노화 연구에 강한 열정이 있다면 어떤 분야의 전공이든 환영합니다. 석사과정 학생은 모집하지 않습니다.

박사과정 (석박사통합과정)

연구실 구성원과의 케미스트리를 확인하기 위한 인턴십 프로그램을 거쳐야 합니다 (최소 2달). KRIBB의 공식 인턴십프로그램이나 UST 인턴십 프로그램을 통해 지원할 수 있습니다.
지원동기와 간단한 약력을 메일로 보내주시면 검토 후 화상면접을 통해 인턴십 프로그램 합격 여부를 결정합니다.



박사후연구원

박사학위 과정에서 수행한 연구가 우리 연구실의 연구와 시너지를 낼 수 있어야 합니다.
우리 연구실의 논문을 검토한 뒤, 본인이 연구실에 어떻게 기여할 수 있을지 제안하는 대면 발표를 진행합니다.

title: Research
text: We study why tissues age unevenly.

title: Research
text:
1 Aging environments

Which tissue environments make cells age? In which organs — and in what order — do aging microenvironments emerge?




What we do
We build single-cell multi-omic atlases to determine the order in which organs age and the changes that arise along the way.


Key papers


Quasi-spatial single-cell transcriptome based on physical tissue properties defines early aging associated niche in liverTak et al., Nature Aging, 2025
Transcriptomic Analysis of Cellular Senescence: One Step Closer to Senescence AtlasKim et al., Molecules and Cells, 2021

title: Research
text:
2 Cell-fate decisions

How does a cell integrate gene regulation, signaling and metabolism to choose senescence over other fates?




What we do
We follow cells longitudinally as they age, in cell and animal models, to define how the senescence fate decision is made, and we run genetic screens for factors that can reverse it.


Key papers


Distinct characteristics of two types of alternative lengthening of telomeres in mouse embryonic stem cellsSung et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2023
Telomeres reforged with non-telomeric sequences in mouse embryonic stem cellsKim et al., Nature Communications, 2021

title: Research
text:
3 From fate to disease

How do these fate decisions feed back to build fibrotic, inflamed and declining tissues?




What we do
We model imperfect repair to understand, at spatial single-cell resolution, how aging microenvironments form.


Key papers

title: Cellular Agenomics Lab
text:
How do cells decide their fate in an aging tissue? We integrate epigenetic, RNA, protein and metabolite data to read how each cell senses its environment, how it remembers past damage, and which environments push it toward aging.

text:
About the lab
Founded in 2020, the Cellular Agenomics Lab is a basic-science laboratory that seeks a deep understanding of why and how mammals age. We combine cell biology, genetics and bioinformatics to understand the cellular basis of aging.

title: Models & Tools
section: Signature method FiNi-seq: Fibrotic Niche Enrichment Sequencing
text:
Signature method FiNi-seq: Fibrotic Niche Enrichment Sequencing



How it works
Aged and fibrotic tissue resists enzymatic dissociation, so its niche cells stay on the cell strainer and are discarded in standard single-cell workflows. FiNi-seq collects these undissociated chunks, digests them again and profiles them by single-cell RNA and ATAC sequencing. In the aged mouse liver it recovers senescent-like endothelial cells, niche fibroblasts, scar-associated macrophages and exhausted-like T cells that standard scRNA-seq misses.


Key paper


Quasi-spatial single-cell transcriptome based on physical tissue properties defines early aging associated niche in liverTak et al., Nature Aging, 2025

title: Models & Tools
text:
Data layers Data we generate




Single-cell multi omics
RNA · Chromatin In-house
scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq on 10x Genomics Chromium, and single-cell combinatorial indexing for scalable profiling.





Bulk sequencing
RNA · Chromatin In-house
Bulk RNA-seq and ATAC-seq, sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq.





Long-read sequencing
RNA isoforms In-house
Nanopore long-read sequencing (P2 Solo) to resolve RNA isoforms and alternative splicing, and genome structural variants.





Spatial transcriptomics · Xenium
Space In-house
10x Genomics Xenium in situ imaging to place cell states in their tissue niche.





Proteomics
Protein Collaboration
Mass-spectrometry proteomics (LC-MS/MS) of tissues and niche fractions.





Metabolomics
Metabolite Collaboration
Metabolite profiling to follow metabolic rewiring with age.

title: Models & Tools
text:
Model systems Models



Cells

Human fibroblasts, LX-2 human hepatic stellate cells, primary mouse hepatocytes, and fibroblasts grown from FiNi-seq chunks
Senescence induced in vitro by DNA damage or drugs



Mouse

Young and aged mice across age
Conditional knockout (cKO) mice
MASH diet and liver fibrosis models
Oncogenic RAS delivery to induce cell-type-specific senescence

title: Models & Tools
text:
Perturb & validate Functional assays




Genetic screening
CRISPR, CRISPRa and ORFeome screens to find factors that set or reverse the senescence fate.





Molecular tools
Cloning and lentiviral vectors to perturb and track genes.





Molecular assays
Real-time PCR and Western blot to measure gene and protein expression.





Tissue validation
Histology and immunofluorescence, RNA FISH (e.g. RNAscope) and telomere FISH to confirm cell states in tissue.

title: Models & Tools
text:
Analysis Computation




We analyze bulk, single-cell, spatial and long-read data in R and Python on in-house Ubuntu servers, using RStudio Server and Docker for reproducible environments, and reanalyze public aging atlases. We write our own code and tools where needed, with AI-assisted programming.
